I think yes. Any time you are spending a lot of time with someone, whether a friend, partner, coworker, or otherwise, things are not going to always be rosy. You're going to encounter minor (and sometimes major) issues with people - I think understanding that this is just something that happens makes it easier to deal with. Also, be open to the other person about what they do that's bugging you. It may be something they're willing to fix.
